Recreate this single document side as a semi-realistic straight-on photograph, matching the provided version, colors, graphic motifs, field positions, aspect ratio, chip/QR/barcodes if visible, and portrait/MRZ zones. Do not redesign, modernize or invent a newer document. Remove numbered explanatory circles, arrows, callouts and outside captions. Replace personal data with fictional DEMO SAMPLE values and placeholder numbers/dates; retain intrinsic field labels and their languages. Preserve each portrait zone in its exact position, render photographic hair and clothes but a blank featureless oval face. No drawn silhouettes or cartoons. Do not invent or add an MRZ absent from the reference. Existing QR/barcode patterns should be illustrative and nonfunctional. Keep all card/page edges visible on a clean white surround with minimal margin. For a passport show the actual biodata page and its book/page construction as in reference, not a generic ID card. Subtle realistic printed material and neutral lighting, not a drawing. Include small but clearly readable 'NOT VALID · DEMO' along an unobstructed edge. One single image, not a contact sheet. This is a visual mockup, not an authentic credential. Replace existing large specimen/sample/MUSTER overlays with the small clearly legible NOT VALID · DEMO label. Preserve only printed intrinsic field numbering; remove explanatory callout circles. Portrait zones, including faint holographic faces, must all have blank featureless faces.

image.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset: document-scanning UI catalogue demo. Input image 1 is the exact layout reference and edit target for Hungría (HU), Pasaporte · Página de datos, model Ver fuente. Recreate this single document side as a semi-realistic straight-on photograph, matching the provided version, colors, graphic motifs, field positions, aspect ratio, chip/QR/barcodes if visible, and portrait/MRZ zones. Do not redesign, modernize or invent a newer document. Remove numbered explanatory circles, arrows, callouts and outside captions. Replace personal data with fictional DEMO SAMPLE values and placeholder numbers/dates; retain intrinsic field labels and their languages. Preserve each portrait zone in its exact position, render photographic hair and clothes but a blank featureless oval face. No drawn silhouettes or cartoons. Preserve the visible MRZ location, line count and typography; replace values with clearly illustrative DEMO text. MRZ is not validated for OCR. Existing QR/barcode patterns should be illustrative and nonfunctional. Keep all card/page edges visible on a clean white surround with minimal margin. For a passport show the actual biodata page and its book/page construction as in reference, not a generic ID card. Subtle realistic printed material and neutral lighting, not a drawing. Include small but clearly readable 'NOT VALID · DEMO' along an unobstructed edge. One single image, not a contact sheet. This is a visual mockup, not an authentic credential. Replace existing large specimen/sample/MUSTER/VOID overlays with the small clearly legible NOT VALID · DEMO label. Preserve only printed intrinsic field numbering; remove explanatory callout circles. Portrait zones, including faint holographic faces, must all have blank featureless faces.
